name: Sultan Mahmud Saad
summary: Embedded Systems and PCB Design Engineer with 4+ years of hands-on experience building IoT products with ESP32, Arduino and Raspberry Pi. Skilled in embedded C/C++ firmware, FreeRTOS and 2-layer PCB design in EasyEDA and KiCad. Builds real-time, sensor-based systems that connect hardware to the cloud over LoRaWAN, MQTT, Wi-Fi and RS485/Modbus for smart manufacturing and industrial automation.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Electrical and Electronic Engineering, CGPA: 3.59/4.00

responsibilities: Design and develop end-to-end embedded system solutions for IoT applications.
Write, test and debug firmware for microcontrollers and embedded processors.
Implement UART, SPI and I2C interfaces and Wi-Fi, BLE and MQTT communication for IoT devices.
Develop real-time applications using FreeRTOS on ESP32 platforms.
Design and lay out printed circuit boards (PCBs) for embedded systems using EasyEDA and KiCad.
Optimize firmware for performance, power efficiency and memory usage in resource-constrained environments.
achievements: Designed and fabricated custom PCBs in EasyEDA that passed manufacturing DRC checks on the first revision.
Designed the Office Automation PCB and a working prototype for SouthernIoT.
Delivered production-grade embedded firmware for IoT devices deployed in live industrial environments.

responsibilities: Worked on paid client projects across hardware, software and PCB design.
Gathered client requirements, defined system architecture and delivered working prototypes on schedule.
Integrated sensors, microcontrollers and cloud backends into complete end-to-end solutions.
achievements: Completed and delivered **multiple paid projects** spanning IoT, automation and PCB design over four years.
Built a strong freelance reputation through consistent on-time delivery and positive client feedback.

projects.title: Careflow V1.0 – Industrial Energy Monitoring System
projects.tech: LoRa, LoRaWAN, ESP32, C++, RS485, RS232, EasyEDA
bullets: Industrial IoT system tracking real-time power, voltage, current, power factor and energy consumption across equipment, using smart meters, edge gateways and cloud or local dashboards.
Implemented a custom LoRaWAN protocol stack for efficient long-range communication; used RS485 and RS232 to interface with generators, UPS units, energy meters and compressors.
Designed a custom PCB in EasyEDA integrating the RAK3312, RAK19007 WisBlock Base Board and an RS485 module for reliable serial communication.

projects.title: ETS – Electronic Token System (RMG Product Tracking)
projects.tech: RAK3312, RAK5802, ILI9341 TFT, MFRC522 RFID
bullets: Developed an IoT-based RMG product tracking system using the RAK3312, an ILI9341 TFT display and an MFRC522 RFID reader to track products across production stations.

projects.title: Office Automation – 4-Channel Relay Controller
projects.tech: ESP32, Relay Module, MQTT, FreeRTOS, EasyEDA
bullets: Built an IoT office automation system to remotely control electrical appliances, with an ESP32 driving a 4-channel relay module for independent switching.
Implemented MQTT for wireless control and real-time monitoring; designed a custom PCB in EasyEDA and used FreeRTOS for multitasking.

projects.title: ESP32 LoRa GPS Tracker
projects.tech: ESP32-S3, EBYTE E22-900M22S (SX1262), ATGM336H GNSS, 915 MHz LoRa, EasyEDA Pro
bullets: Two-board tracker: a battery GPS node sends its position over 915 MHz LoRa to a base station that serves a live map over Wi-Fi, with no SIM card or cloud service.
**Objective:** deliver low-cost, long-range location tracking that keeps working where there is no mobile network, with position data kept private on a local radio link and no SIM or cloud fees.
**Real-World Use:** tracking delivery vehicles, livestock and field staff on farms, tea gardens and construction sites, and following rescue teams or hikers in remote or disaster-hit areas.

projects.title: ESP32 IoT Vehicle Motion Analyzer
projects.tech: ESP32-S3, MPU6050, LIS3MDL, SSD1306 OLED, LittleFS, EasyEDA Pro
bullets: Detects harsh braking, harsh acceleration and sharp turns in real time, with a tilt-compensated compass heading shown on an onboard OLED.
**Objective:** measure driving behaviour in real time so unsafe habits can be detected, logged and reduced, using a self-contained device that needs no mobile app or internet connection.
**Real-World Use:** fleet, bus and ride-sharing operators monitoring driver safety, driving schools giving trainees feedback, and trip logs supporting insurance claims and accident analysis.

projects.title: ESP32 MLX90640 IR Thermal Camera
projects.tech: ESP32-WROOM-32, MLX90640 IR Array, Wi-Fi Access Point, EasyEDA Pro
bullets: Battery-powered thermal camera that reads a 32x24 (768-pixel) IR array over 800 kHz I2C and streams temperatures to a browser viewer from its own Wi-Fi access point.
**Objective:** build an affordable, portable thermal imager that shows live temperature maps on any phone or laptop, as a low-cost alternative to commercial handheld thermal cameras.
**Real-World Use:** finding overheating breakers, cables and motors in factory electrical panels, locating PCB hot spots during testing, and inspecting HVAC and solar installations.

projects.title: IoT Activity Tracker
projects.tech: ESP32-S3, BNO085 9-DOF IMU, SSD1306 OLED, Wi-Fi Dashboard, EasyEDA Pro
bullets: Wearable-style tracker for steps, cadence, distance, calories and orientation, with automatic STILL / MOVE / WALK / RUN activity classification.
**Objective:** create a low-cost, open-hardware wearable that tracks daily movement and orientation accurately and shares live data over Wi-Fi without a proprietary smartwatch ecosystem.
**Real-World Use:** personal fitness tracking, activity monitoring for elderly people at home, physiotherapy recovery tracking, and worker-movement studies for factory ergonomics.
